verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes CrewAI's agent/task/crew/memory/CLI/MCP features and its Enterprise/AMP managed hosting, but contains no documentation, API, or statement about exporting user data (memory, traces, crew configs, deployment data) in open/portable formats or about easing migration away from the platform. Missing for 10: any explicit data-export tooling, open-format guarantees, or migration/portability documentation, especially for the hosted Enterprise/AMP offering.
